mentions.claim_text: He says maybe they will come out with a peace agreement and that he would love to be wrong about what he believes he has been shown concerning war, and that he saw lavender on the fields and the people of Russia praying.
mentions.quote: I would love to be wrong for what I believe I've been shown
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian peace and a religious movement there.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. He states plainly that he hopes to be wrong, which is rare here.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the Canadian prime minister announcing sanctions on Russia and says he is joining up with them.
mentions.quote: he's going to put sanctions on Russia, too
mentions.falsify_match: Canada aligns with the European escalation bloc.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has seen Turkey and Syria in the days ahead with a planned attack, people in red hats marching out of Syria and Turkey, and a ground invasion coming from Turkey.
mentions.quote: a planned attack with people with red hats on marching out of Syria
mentions.falsify_match: A Turkish ground invasion out of Syria.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls seeing splits in the road in Europe so deep you could not see the bottom, which his co-host identifies as a major earthquake, and turns to a 6.4 in China.
mentions.quote: I saw splits in the road and you couldn't see down in the ground
mentions.falsify_match: A European earthquake opening ground fissures.

mentions.claim_text: He says the 6.4 in China that day is the temples being shaken down as promised, and that violent earthquakes will be seen and will increase.
mentions.quote: He said he was going to shake temples down
mentions.falsify_match: Ancient temples brought down by earthquakes.
mentions.falsify_miss: No temple collapses. A 6.4 in China is not unusual and no temple damage is cited.

mentions.claim_text: Shown footage from Missouri that looks like a firework, he says he had said it would increase, and turns to a Russia and Turkey meeting which he says is the one the Lord told him about.
mentions.quote: I said Russia Turkey will come to the aid of Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey materially aids Russia.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip saying Israel's stance on the region is a problem for the entire world, and objects to something the president said about using it.
mentions.quote: It's a problem for the entire world
mentions.falsify_match: International isolation of Israel deepens.

mentions.claim_text: He says what he keeps seeing is a great betrayal from the United States toward Israel, that Russia and Turkey are supporting each other, that Turkey joins Russia and comes against Israel in the days ahead, and that they will shut off the strait at the Black Sea.
mentions.quote: I saw Turkey joining up with Russia and coming against Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey aligns with Russia against Israel and closes the strait.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them they would be talking about the Black Sea and the strait and shutting off the waterway, and that the Turkish leader will come out as a tyrant like a vampire, and that it is starting.
mentions.quote: they're going to come out as a tyrant with a like a vampire
mentions.falsify_match: The strait is closed to shipping by Turkey.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was in a meeting in the spirit and heard them say they are tired of playing the cat and mouse game, with the Russian president speaking to the man in Ukraine.
mentions.quote: We're tired of playing the cat and mouse game
mentions.falsify_match: A qualitative Russian escalation follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: The war continues at the same intensity.

mentions.claim_text: Told an underwater volcano is about to erupt, he says he talked about it in the last video and that he saw it coming because of the dying fish and told them to watch the fish.
mentions.quote: I said an underwater volcano is about to erupt
mentions.falsify_match: An undersea eruption off the northwest coast.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls people in Quebec wanting to leave Canada and become an American state, and says that when asked whether he was sure he saw British Columbia he answered after the earthquake.
mentions.quote: Are you sure you saw British Columbia? I said, After the earthquake
mentions.falsify_match: A Canadian province moves toward joining the United States.

mentions.claim_text: He describes people weeping at the end of a film, tracts being handed out, and revival with healings and conversions in movie theatres across America and the world, and says to watch this movie.
mentions.quote: people were having revival and being healed and born again in movie theaters
mentions.falsify_match: A film release produces documented mass conversions in cinemas.

mentions.claim_text: He says the technology will be used for the beast system before it turns into the mark of the beast, that they should use it first, and that Starlink will be used in the days ahead for the Antichrist.
mentions.quote: he'll use Starlink in the days ahead for for the Antichrist
mentions.falsify_match: Satellite and neural interface technology becomes an identification system.

mentions.claim_text: He notes someone lost their furniture and everything in a fire and had a hard time, then turns to Germany saying it is ready to fight Russia.
mentions.quote: Germany is ready to fight Russia
mentions.falsify_match: German forces engage Russia.

mentions.claim_text: He names New Orleans, Houston, San Francisco, Dallas and New York together, and sees women in provocative clothing with American flags on their arms and patriotic sparkles, one of them a black woman.
mentions.quote: provocative clothes, but American flag on their arms
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at a patriotic event in one of the named cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The description matches ordinary Fourth of July crowds.

mentions.claim_text: He says it has to do with Cuba, France and New Orleans, sees the fox looking toward New Orleans, and begins an analogy about the ticking of a gas stove pilot light.
mentions.quote: it has to do with Cuba, France, and New Orleans
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuba or France linked action against New Orleans.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. France is new to this set.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that the fox is looking toward New Orleans and compares what he is sensing to the ticking of a gas stove pilot light before it catches.
mentions.quote: you hear that tick tick tick tick
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on New Orleans.

mentions.claim_text: He says he heard and saw in news articles an escalation coming with Israel and Netanyahu acting alone, and asks for a fan to be turned on mid-sentence.
mentions.quote: an escalation of things coming with Israel and Benjamin acting alone
mentions.falsify_match: Israel acts unilaterally against Iran.

mentions.claim_text: He says what will be seen is not the United States doing it, that Israel will strike Iran alone in the days ahead, and that there will be great antisemitism across the land.
mentions.quote: Israel will strike Iran in the days ahead alone
mentions.falsify_match: An Israeli strike on Iran without American participation.
mentions.falsify_miss: America participates, or no strike occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says Jews will go home out of great persecution and that great antisemitism comes when Israel strikes alone, states plainly that he can miss it, and says he saw them striking oil wells.
mentions.quote: Now, can I miss it? Yes
mentions.falsify_match: Israeli strikes on Iranian oil wells followed by a rise in antisemitism.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. He attaches an explicit possibility of error.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a room with bars on the windows where many Latino men were being tortured greatly with chemicals and psychological warfare.
mentions.quote: they were torturing these men with chemical
mentions.falsify_match: A torture facility of that description is exposed.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. He does not say where the room is.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a large bushy faced fox in a hat watching him as he prayed and a witch in a top hat like a skeleton man, which the Lord called voodoo.
mentions.quote: the Lord said, This is voodoo
mentions.falsify_match: The fox resolves to an identifiable actor.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is dealing with it and lifting the darkness, that a great shaking is coming to Cuba, that a major revival is coming and he will liberate the people, and that the president was ready to move.
mentions.quote: A MAJOR REVIVAL is coming. I'm going to liberate the people
mentions.falsify_match: Cuba is liberated and a revival follows.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to pray for the secretary of state for wisdom because he will slay his tens of thousands while Saul slays his thousands, identifies Saul as the vice president, and says he saw Rubio rise with favour among Latinos and Cubans.
mentions.quote: he will slay his tens of thousands and Saul will slay his thousands
mentions.falsify_match: Rubio outperforms Vance politically.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to look at the president with Kennedy, that he heard old alliances with Russia, saw patches of stars on shoulders he could not interpret, and that a major event is about to take place in Cuba with a shaking over the nation.
mentions.quote: the Lord said specifically look at Trump with Kennedy
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuba crisis framed on Kennedy era lines.

mentions.claim_text: He says Israel said exactly what they saw the night before, that they are not happy, that they are sovereign and will act alone, and that the word is coming to pass.
mentions.quote: They said, We'll act alone. So, the word that we saw is coming to pass
mentions.falsify_match: Israel acts militarily without American participation.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Israeli statements of sovereign action are routine and predate this word.

mentions.claim_text: He plays Netanyahu saying he sometimes does not agree with the American president and that Israel will do whatever it takes to maintain its own security, and says what they saw the night before is manifesting within twelve to twenty four hours as an acceleration.
mentions.quote: What we saw last night is manifesting less than 12 hours later
mentions.falsify_match: A specific Israeli action he named in advance follows within a day.
mentions.falsify_miss: Only a general statement of sovereignty follows, which is the standing Israeli position.

mentions.claim_text: On reports of Israeli shelling in southern Lebanon he says the prime minister is defying what the president wanted just as the Lord said he would, and acting alone.
mentions.quote: he's defying what Trump said he wanted him to do just like the Lord said
mentions.falsify_match: An open Israel and America rupture over Lebanon.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a Russian statement that Germany seems to be showing Nazi instincts again and says there it is, that he told them they would summon it.
mentions.quote: Germany seems to be showing Nazi instincts again
mentions.falsify_match: German remilitarisation on a scale that draws that comparison broadly.
mentions.falsify_miss: It stays a Russian talking point. Russian officials have used the Nazi comparison for Germany throughout the war.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a swastika coming up out of Berlin and spreading across Europe like a Batman signal, asks whether anyone remembers, and says they will call it the Hitler spirit again over Europe.
mentions.quote: I saw a swastika coming up out of Berlin that looked like a Batman signal
mentions.falsify_match: A far right resurgence across Europe centred on Germany.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that Germany's foreign minister said the German military will increase exchange of experience with Ukraine's armed forces, framing it as ramping up military projects.
mentions.quote: the German military will boost the exchange of experience with Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: German forces become directly involved.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they remember him seeing the California governor rising to be president, and says that when he was finished in California he slithered on his belly as a serpent in a demonic trance with a forked tongue licking the ground.
mentions.quote: He slithered on his belly as a serpent
mentions.falsify_match: Newsom moves from California to a national campaign.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a divorce and says he saw an advocate talking with the man, then says he saw the money sent to Ukraine in secret bank accounts, twenty four billion dollars.
mentions.quote: I saw the money that was sent to Ukraine was in secret bank accounts
mentions.falsify_match: A diversion of Ukraine aid of that scale is documented.

mentions.claim_text: He says American tax dollars funded campaigns through Ukraine, that twenty four billion went into those accounts, and that it went into Swiss accounts and certain places in South Africa, funnelled by tens of millions.
mentions.quote: they went into Swiss accounts. They went into some places in South Africa
mentions.falsify_match: Funds traced to Swiss and South African accounts.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such trace. The twenty four billion figure appears elsewhere in this corpus attached to a domestic party slush fund instead.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the United Kingdom sending six thousand laser guided missiles to Ukraine to counter Russian drone attacks, asks whether they are long range, and says he saw things that looked like them.
mentions.quote: The UK is sending 6,000 laser guided missiles to Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: Long range British missiles strike deep into Russia.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are short range air defence, which is what countering drones implies.

mentions.claim_text: He says the emergency number disruption is a trial run and a practice run for what he has seen, a red dawn experience not just in America but in Hawaii and outside the states, and mentions malls with luxury shops.
mentions.quote: This is a trial run. This is a practice run for what I have seen
mentions.falsify_match: A larger coordinated attack follows the emergency system disruptions.
mentions.falsify_miss: None follows. Calling an event a practice run means any absence of the larger event is not yet a miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says they must push the elections through for the right candidates and keep uncovering great fraud in California and other states, naming a figure and referring to fraud he calls Simoleons.
mentions.quote: keep uncovering this great fraud in California and in these other states
mentions.falsify_match: Documented election fraud findings in California.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is trouble on the streets and that the Lord told him to pray, that he prays peace over his own city all the time, and turns to the French president not wanting to be there.
mentions.quote: I pray peace over my city all the time, Tulsa
mentions.falsify_match: Unrest reaching his own city.

mentions.claim_text: He says weeks earlier he saw a scorpion tail going through England and Australia for a new digital currency and a coming one world order, and told them to watch Canada and its prime minister in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: I saw a scorpion tail go through England, Australia, and for a new digital currency
mentions.falsify_match: Digital currency and identity systems introduced across those Commonwealth states.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not a coincidence that the picture was taken right next to Kennedy when it could have been taken anywhere, and that the man is covered by the blood.
mentions.quote: they could have taken the picture anywhere but right next to Kennedy
mentions.falsify_match: The administration confirms a Kennedy era framing for Cuba policy.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. A photograph's backdrop is read as deliberate signalling.

mentions.claim_text: He notes people will still be able to use social media by verifying identity with a digital ID, says they will block Musk, and that just as he said they will come against first amendment rights starting with the children.
mentions.quote: they're going to say it with the kids first
mentions.falsify_match: Digital identity becomes mandatory for social media access.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of a rebirthing of America concerning the church, floodgates of goodness and mercy passing by, and a shaking to awaken, saying it is two sides of a coin.
mentions.quote: A rebirthing of America. It's concerning the church
mentions.falsify_match: A national religious resurgence following a shock.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Two sides of a coin means hardship and blessing both count.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls the Lord showing them at nearly one in the morning on the Thursday to pray for her, and fast forwards to what is happening now.
mentions.quote: whenever the Lord showed us that at the very end to pray for her
mentions.falsify_match: The person prayed for is identified and something happens to them.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a man coming down steps and says the Lord told him he must intercede for his life because there will be an attempt that will be successful, adding that the man was holding the church accountable for how they pray.
mentions.quote: there will be an attempt that will be successful
mentions.falsify_match: A successful attempt on the life of the figure he describes.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He does not name the man in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a visitation in the White House with a woman named Erica sitting on a couch talking about losing her husband and consoling America and the president, and seven blackened oak trees.
mentions.quote: I saw a seven oak trees that were blacked
mentions.falsify_match: A widow of a prominent figure takes a public consoling role at the White House.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. Elsewhere four oaks were read tentatively as four years; here there are seven, blackened.

mentions.claim_text: He says he heard for the first time that the president is going to France for three days, Monday to Wednesday, with a dinner with the French president, and reacted with dismay.
mentions.quote: I'm going to France. And I went, oh no
mentions.falsify_match: The trip takes place as described.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the president heading to the G7 in France after reaching a deal to end the war with Iran, asks whether the deal sticks and whether this is the reprieve that brings Ezekiel 38, and says he saw a pause and a blow for blow.
mentions.quote: Is this the reprieve that brings forth Ezekiel 38 39?
mentions.falsify_match: The Iran deal holds as a pause before a wider war.
mentions.falsify_miss: The deal holds permanently, or collapses without a wider war. He puts it as a question rather than an assertion.

mentions.claim_text: He says a major escalation of war is coming because of what Europe is doing, and that he saw a black web with a black widow going from place to place representing the Ukrainian president trying to provoke a major war with Europe.
mentions.quote: a web that was black with a black widow that went from place to place
mentions.falsify_match: A European war provoked through Zelensky's coalition building.

mentions.claim_text: He corrects himself from Greece to Turkey, saying Turkey will rise up like a vampire in the days ahead, seen in a vampire cloak and furious.
mentions.quote: Turkey will rise up like a vampire in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey turns hostile to the West.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He names Greece first and corrects himself, saying it was in his mind.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip about not just responding to challenges but being a step ahead, says the wrong video played, and that they were said to be united like Hitler, which he had seen in the spirit.
mentions.quote: He said they were united like Hitler
mentions.falsify_match: A European bloc forms that draws that comparison widely.

mentions.claim_text: He describes it going over England with Big Ben turning into a moon, says the imagery was symbolic, and that he saw churches burning, a major shaking to awaken, a major revival and war with Turkey beating war drums.
mentions.quote: with the Big Ben turning into a moon
mentions.falsify_match: Islamic ascendancy in Britain alongside church fires.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. He marks the imagery symbolic himself.

mentions.claim_text: He notes Russia is out of gas and needs to get some, then turns to the water, saying he had told them the water infrastructure was a target.
mentions.quote: I told you our water infrastructure was a target
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on American water infrastructure.

mentions.claim_text: He says outages of weeks would follow attacks on substations, and points to a California water system hit by Iranian hackers as a threat to drinking supplies, saying they shut down the cleaning of the water just as the Lord told him.
mentions.quote: California water system hit by Iran hackers
mentions.falsify_match: A water treatment system is disabled by attack.
mentions.falsify_miss: The incident is an intrusion without loss of service. He treats a hack and a shutdown as the same thing.

mentions.claim_text: He says the young man's influence will be strong through how he talks and communicates with people, like his father's, and notes a reported eightieth birthday phone call from Russia.
mentions.quote: His influence will be strong
mentions.falsify_match: The son becomes a prominent public communicator.
